title: Notes API with User Accounts
objective: Introduce user-specific data and access control.

milestones.title: Milestone 1: Registration and login workflow
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate registration and login workflow in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 2: Private notes and account-scoped retrieval
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate private notes and account-scoped retrieval in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 3: Safe password handling and session/token expiry
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate safe password handling and session/token expiry in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 4: Ownership rules with positive and negative tests
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate ownership rules with positive and negative tests in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

required_features: Safe password handling and session/token expiry
Ownership rules with positive and negative tests
stretch_features: Add contract validation to CI and detect a breaking change.
Add structured request IDs and useful metrics without logging secrets.
Document a recovery or migration trade-off with alternatives.
tests: Test success, missing-resource, validation, and authorization outcomes.
Test duplicates and concurrent updates where the domain has non-idempotent side effects.
Run tests against a disposable database with deterministic fixtures.
Review public responses and logs for secret or personal-data exposure.
review_method: Automated tests and static contract checks plus human review against the rubric; no arbitrary learner code executes inside CodeLeaf’s production API.
status_note: Unreviewed project draft; validate scope, starter files, rubric and implementation assumptions before publication.
